
```{devoirs_choices trajectory_13_two_choices}

    correct: false

- A function describing the state as it evolves from an initial condition.:

- A sequence of time values with no corresponding state values.:

- The time-evolving state produced by applying the dynamical rule and accounting method.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
```
